title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,895.79 down -114.25 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Monday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,895.79. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.23 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 2.06 to 1 ratio. There were 1005 advancers and 2075 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 23 stocks reached a 52 week high and 55 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -1.47% for the day; a total of -110.77 points. The current value is 7,434.73. JD.com, Inc. ( JD ) had the largest percent change down (-5.09%) while Express Scripts Holding Company ( ESRX ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.77%.
The Dow Jones index closed down -.35% for the day; a total of -92.55 points. The current value is 26,062.12. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-2.64%) while Caterpillar, Inc. ( CAT ) had the largest percent change gain rising .91%.
